node: Healthcare and nursing licensure education capacity: ABSN, OTA, simulation technology, VR training, prerequisites, and clinical-placement support
summary: Layer 1B expansion finds two direct education asset/service owners with high exposure to healthcare licensure capacity, one niche healthcare workforce software supplier, and one micro-cap speculative AR/VR simulation supplier. The strongest direct fits are LOPE and ATGE because their disclosed businesses explicitly include ABSN, OTA, nursing, healthcare programs, campuses, online delivery, simulation labs, or partner operations. HSTM is a second-order supplier to healthcare organizations, nursing schools, and nursing students. ZSPC is a speculative shadow candidate because it has direct AR/VR healthcare-training evidence but is far below the preferred market-cap range and depends heavily on education budgets.
